title: plugin-dashboard: DashboardGridLayout.datasetPath.test.tsx has its own real-network escape (same class as #5225 / #5280, different file)
body:
Found while fixing #5280 (`DatasetWidget.test.tsx`, now closed by that card's PR). Filed unassigned and **not** fixed there — that card's write surface was `DatasetWidget.test.tsx` only, and this is a **different file** with the same class of defect.

## The escape

```
pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardGridLayout.datasetPath.test.tsx 2>&1 | grep -c ECONNREFUSED
-> 2   # 1 real connection attempt
   Tests  13 passed (13)
```

Reproduced 3/3 consecutive runs in isolation (`origin/main` post-#5207, merge-base `7260a1ed4` / this repo's HEAD at filing time `6c4c090e6`). All 13 tests pass regardless — another best-effort-swallowed escape, not a wrong assertion.

Package-wide (`pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-dashboard`, 64 files / 581 tests) now shows an intermittent 1-attempt residual (0 or 2 ECONNREFUSED lines run to run) **after** #5280 closed `DatasetWidget.test.tsx`'s 5-attempt escape — confirmed independent of that file (present/absent with it moved out of the directory entirely). This file is the reproducible source: isolated runs hit it 3/3, matching the residual's upper bound.

## Why I did not just fix it here

#5280's file surface was `DatasetWidget.test.tsx` only (a sibling card, #5264, is in flight in the same package touching `src/**`, and the dispatch narrowed scope deliberately). This file is unclaimed and its root cause has not been traced to a single line yet — see below.

## What's confirmed vs. what still needs tracing

Confirmed:
- The file imports `@object-ui/components` and `@object-ui/plugin-charts` at module scope and renders `DashboardGridLayout`, which routes dataset-bound widgets through `DatasetWidget` (same `useDatasetDimensionMeta` chain as #5225/#5280) **and** routes a separate legacy `options.data.provider: 'object'` widget shape through `@object-ui/plugin-charts`' `object-chart` component (the ORIGINAL #4106 defect site, before it was extracted into the shared hook by #4389).
- None of this file's `queryDataset` mock **results** declare an `object` field (they're all `{ rows, fields }` only), which should make `useDatasetDimensionMeta`'s own `!object` guard a no-op for every dataset-bound case here — so the escape most likely is NOT coming through that hook via the dataset path.
- The file's two `object: 'invoices'` / `provider: 'object', object: 'invoices'` fixtures (lines ~209-223, ~237, ~246) are the more likely candidates: the legacy `object-chart` color/metadata path and/or the `isLegacyRetiredWidget` sentinel path, both of which carry an `object` name on the **widget schema** itself rather than on a query result.
- This plausibly explains the "`GET .../meta/object/invoices x1`" line in #5280's original capture, which #5280's own fix (scoped to `DatasetWidget.test.tsx`, which has no `invoices` fixture at all) could not have produced — i.e. that one request was very likely always coming from this file, mis-attributed in the original per-file bisect.

Not yet confirmed: the exact `it()` case and the exact fetch call site. A `-t` bisect across this file's 13 cases (or a `net.Socket.prototype.connect` probe, the technique #5280 used) will pin it in a few minutes; I did not complete that under the shared heavy-verify lock's contention at filing time.

## Suggested fix shape

If the source turns out to be the same `apiFetch ?? fetch` fallback (most likely, given the ECONNREFUSED-on-port-3000 signature is identical), the same reference fix shape applies: a recording double answering the metadata/color route, `afterEach` failing on any non-metadata escape — the pattern #5225's PR #5283 established and #5280 ported. If it turns out to be a genuinely different call site (e.g. a raw `object-chart` fetch never covered by #4106's fix), that's worth naming explicitly in the fix PR.

## Note on pre-filing search

The GitHub search API was rate-limited (shared identity, 429s on every `search_issues`/`list_issues` call) at filing time, so I could not run a duplicate check beyond reading #5225 and #5280 themselves (neither mentions this file). Please dedupe against anything else in flight if this overlaps.

## Recheck

```
pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardGridLayout.datasetPath.test.tsx 2>&1 | grep -c ECONNREFUSED
```

Run vitest from the repo root (objectui#3378).
